flow.metadata["sandbox_run_id"]: str

metadata = flow.metadata
metadata["firewall_name"]: str


def annotation_only_subscript_does_not_invoke_getitem(flow, manager, target):
    metadata = flow.metadata
    with manager:
        target["external"]: object
        metadata = {}
    return metadata["firewall_name"]


def annotation_only_container_call_is_eager(flow, manager, container):
    metadata = flow.metadata
    with manager:
        container()["external"]: object
        metadata = {}
    return metadata["firewall_name"]


def annotation_only_index_call_is_eager(flow, manager, target, index):
    metadata = flow.metadata
    with manager:
        target[index()]: object
        metadata = {}
    return metadata["firewall_name"]
